subtitle.default: ✦ TOP OF THE CITY – INVESTORS ONLY

description.default:
Welcome to an exclusive Investor Brunch at Seid, located at the very top of the city in the iconic K8 building. Set on the 16th floor, Seid offers a unique setting with panoramic views of Stavanger.

Expect an intimate, investor-only gathering designed for deeper conversations, partnership exploration, and co-investment discussions. No pitches — just you and your investor peers building meaningful relationships over a premium brunch experience.
